# Zinely Chatting Agency

> Zinely (also "Zinely Chatting Agency", "Zinely Agency") is a 24/7 human chatting agency for OnlyFans, Fanvue and Fansly. It manages DMs, PPV sales, tips and fan follow-ups for creators, agencies and AI-model operators who already bring their own traffic. Website: https://zinelyagency.com/

## How Zinely chats

- Human chatters send every message. AI never chats with fans.
- Zinely builds its own tools and uses AI behind the scenes to give chatters each fan's context: past conversations, purchases, preferences, boundaries, payday and notes from earlier shifts. The chatter reads that context before replying, so a fan never has to start over with a new shift.
- Team leads review conversations, and coverage is monitored around the clock; missed shifts are covered.
- Works with real creators and AI-model (AI influencer) accounts. For an AI-generated persona, human chatters follow the operator's character guide; AI context keeps the persona's details consistent.

## Terms (see the pricing page for current details)

- Commission only on the net tips and PPV that Zinely chatters close. No commission on subscriptions or renewals.
- No retainers, minimums or lock-in. Weekly invoices on Mondays. Stop anytime with no notice period or exit fee.
- Trial week: seven days of 24/7 chatting at the normal commission, nothing upfront, no commitment after day 7. For accounts averaging 9–10 or more new free subscribers a day.
- Account access: none needed for the estimate; set up with the platform's supported options and agreed in writing before launch; removed when work ends.
- Onboarding usually within 24 hours, depending on account readiness.
- Chatting does not replace traffic: Zinely works best for accounts that already have an audience.
